turns.text: Hello, I moved today and need to update the delivery address for my order.
Hello! I can help with that. Please send me your order number (like SC-1234) and the email the order was placed with, plus the new delivery address.
The order number is SC-4040 and my email is george.miller.v2@example.com. New address is Str. Exemplu 63, Timisoara.

Thank you. Your order has already shipped, and the address can only be changed before shipping. I've passed your request, with the new address Str. Exemplu 63, Timisoara, to a colleague. They will take over and decide what can be done.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

input.summary: Customer (george.miller.v2@example.com) moved today and wants to change the delivery address of SC-4040 to: Str. Exemplu 63, Timisoara. Policy check says the order has already shipped, so the change cannot be filed automatically. Staff must decide.
